name: Leftovers
description: Restores 1/16 of the holder's max HP at the end of each turn.

name: Lum Berry
description: Cures any status condition and confusion. Consumed on use.

name: Sitrus Berry
description: Restores 25% of the holder's max HP when HP falls to half or less. Consumed on use.

name: Shuca Berry
description: Halves damage from a super-effective Ground-type move. Consumed on use.

name: Rocky Helmet
description: Damages the attacker for 1/6 of their max HP when they use a contact move.

name: Black Belt
description: Boosts the power of Fighting-type moves by 20%.

name: Hard Stone
description: Boosts the power of Rock-type moves by 20%.

name: Focus Sash
description: If holder has full HP, it survives a hit that would KO it with 1 HP. Consumed on use.

name: Weakness Policy
description: If the holder is hit by a super-effective move, its Attack and Sp. Atk are sharply raised. Consumed on use.

name: Choice Scarf
description: Boosts the holder's Speed by 50%, but only allows use of the first move selected.

name: Choice Band
description: Boosts the holder's Attack by 50%, but only allows use of the first move selected.

name: Choice Specs
description: Boosts the holder's Sp. Atk by 50%, but only allows use of the first move selected.

name: Life Orb
description: Boosts the power of moves by 30% but costs 10% HP per use.

name: Assault Vest
description: Raises Sp. Def by 50% but prevents use of status moves.

name: Throat Spray
description: Raises the holder's Sp. Atk by 1 stage when it uses a sound-based move. Consumed on use.

name: Safety Goggles
description: Protects the holder from powder moves and the effects of weather.

name: Clear Amulet
description: Prevents the holder's stats from being lowered by other Pokemon's moves or abilities.

name: Covert Cloak
description: Protects the holder from the additional effects of moves used against it.

name: Loaded Dice
description: Makes multi-strike moves more likely to hit more times.

name: Booster Energy
description: Activates the Quark Drive or Protosynthesis abilities even without terrain or weather.

name: Quick Claw
description: Gives the holder a 20% chance to move first in its priority bracket each turn.

name: Focus Band
description: Gives the holder a 10% chance to survive a hit that would otherwise KO it, leaving 1 HP.

name: White Herb
description: Restores lowered stats to normal once. Consumed on use.
